description: One entry per service. verdict must be: free-forever | trial | card-trap | credit-based

services.name: Cloudflare Pages
services.catch: Builds pause at 500/month — fine for hobby projects
services.bestfor: Static sites, portfolios, sites with light serverless functions

services.name: GitHub Pages
services.limits: 1 GB site, 100 GB/month bandwidth, static only
services.catch: Static sites only — no server code

services.name: Vercel Hobby
services.catch: Commercial use technically not allowed on Hobby plan

services.name: Netlify Free
services.catch: Build minutes run out fast if you redeploy constantly
services.bestfor: Static sites with forms and edge functions

services.name: Render
services.limits: Free web service spins down after 15 min idle
services.catch: Card required upfront; cold starts make it feel broken
services.bestfor: Nothing free — the free tier exists to funnel you upward
services.alt: Oracle Cloud free VM (always-on, no cold starts)

services.name: Oracle Cloud Free Tier
services.limits: Up to 4 ARM cores + 24 GB RAM — genuinely huge
services.catch: Card needed just to sign up (verification); popular regions often out of capacity
services.bestfor: A real always-on Linux server — the strongest free deal in hosting
services.alt: A ~$4/month VPS if your region has no capacity

services.name: AWS Free Tier
services.limits: Most offers last 12 months only; some services always-free
services.catch: Card required; after 12 months you get billed unless you shut everything down
services.bestfor: Learning real cloud skills; short, watched experiments
services.alt: Oracle Cloud (no expiry), GCP always-free slice

services.name: Supabase
services.limits: 2 projects, 500 MB database, pauses after 1 week inactivity
services.catch: Project pauses if unused for 7 days — click to restore
services.bestfor: Auth + Postgres + storage for side projects, all in one

services.name: MongoDB Atlas
services.catch: Shared cluster is slow; fine for learning
services.bestfor: Learning NoSQL; small apps with light traffic
services.alt: Supabase if you'd rather learn Postgres

services.name: Neon
services.catch: Cold-start delay after inactivity; compute hours capped monthly
services.alt: Supabase (no cold start, but project pauses)

services.name: Upstash
services.catch: Per-command pricing means a popular app quietly exceeds the daily cap
services.bestfor: Caching, rate limiting, small queues between serverless functions
services.alt: Redis on an Oracle free VM (uncapped, self-managed)

services.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)
services.limits: Free tier with per-day request limits on Gemini models
services.catch: Free tier data may be used by Google for improvement — don't send sensitive prompts
services.bestfor: Prototyping with frontier-grade models at zero cost

services.name: Groq Cloud
services.limits: Free tier with rate limits, very fast LLMs
services.catch: Rate limits hit hard on free tier; needs monitoring
services.bestfor: Agents and real-time features that need sub-second tokens

services.name: OpenRouter
services.limits: Many models have ':free' variants with daily request caps
services.catch: Free models get throttled and can disappear anytime; paid models need credits
services.bestfor: Testing many models with one key before committing
services.alt: Each provider's own free tier (Gemini, Groq)

services.name: Resend
services.catch: 100/day sounds small but covers most hobby projects
services.alt: Brevo free tier (300/day) if you outgrow it
